title: Esthetic outcome of immediately placed and nonfunctionally loaded implants in the anterior maxilla utilizing a definitive abutment: A pilot clinical trial
authors: AlTarawneh S, Hamdan AAS, Alhadidi A, Hattar S, Al -Rabab'ah M, Baqain Z. Dent Res J (Isfahan). 2020 Mar;17(2):92-99.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Immediate placement and nonfunctional loading utilizing a definitive abutment appear to result in a stable result as far as esthetic outcome and alveolar process sufficiency are concerned” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
